final_payload.rationale_summary: The initial exact selector attempt failed with a typed recoverable failure; the retry contract indicated model-owned semantic repair and unresolved roles/requirements. I revised the selector to resolve all four observations across the required dates, computed the three interval growth rates, derived the mean of the first two intervals, and compared it to the 1972-03-09–1972-03-10 growth. The comparison result showed the later interval exceeded the mean; the difference is reported below.
